revisions.content: {"id":"spider-heart-web","prompt":"Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this brown friendly spider, its exactly eight legs, expressive face, body and composition. Change ONLY the heart-shaped web above it: redraw the heart web with crisp clean smooth charcoal-brown strands, eight radial spokes and three curved connector rings, with subtly cream-lit edges. All holes between strands must be fully transparent, no gray-white film or fog or fringe. This is a polished hand-inked original cutout. The spider remains attached by one clean narrow silk line. Fit the complete composition with 6 percent transparent margin. No matte, no glow, no text. Preserve character detail; simplify only excessive web texture into clean silk strands."}

The small heart web should have only five crisp narrow smooth radial silk spokes and two cross rings, not thick shiny tubing. Preserve the spider's polished expressive face, rich brown shading and eight distinctly separate legs. Keep generous clear margins and absolutely transparent gaps.
